title: Site settings
description: Choose how you read and navigate this site. Tap an option to cycle through its values. Changes apply immediately and are saved in this browser.

sections.title: Reading
sections.help: Text size and line spacing apply to article paragraphs and lists.

fields.label: Text brightness
fields.help: Choose softer grays or brighter text, headings, and menus in dark mode.

sections.title: Layout
sections.help: The layout adapts to the space available, including browser zoom. Text size remains a separate reading preference.

fields.label: Site width
fields.help: Use more space for navigation, cards, tables, and diagrams. Paragraphs retain a comfortable reading width.

fields.label: Interface density
fields.help: Compact mode tightens gaps, padding, and indentation while preserving text size.

fields.label: Page outline
fields.help: Prefer visible keeps the outline beside the article in smaller windows. A header button opens it when space is limited.

sections.title: Navigation
sections.help: Saved panel widths apply when space permits. Compact layouts fit panels around the article; navigation remains available from the menu.

fields.label: Show top bar
fields.help: Keep the main navigation and reading controls visible. A floating button restores the bar when hidden.

fields.label: Show left navigation
fields.help: Show the navigation pane on larger screens. The mobile menu remains available.

fields.label: Keep parent sections visible
fields.help: Pin the current path in the left navigation and page outline while scrolling.

fields.label: Edit color palette
fields.help: Adjust backgrounds, text, headings, breadcrumbs, and navigation for the current theme in a floating panel that leaves the page visible. Changes preview live and are saved in this browser.

previewText: Good explanations connect ideas, evidence, and decisions. Adjust the font, spacing, and brightness until this text feels comfortable to read.
transferHelp: Export saves your reading, layout, navigation and color choices, including named palettes, to a file you can import in another browser.

messages.requiresJavaScript: Enable JavaScript to change your site settings.
messages.ready: Changes are saved automatically in this browser.
messages.saveFailed: Applied to this page. Your browser could not save these settings.
messages.resetFailed: Defaults applied to this page. Your browser could not save these settings.
messages.importSaveFailed: Settings imported for this page. Your browser could not save them.
messages.importFailed: That file is not a settings export from this site.
